title: Uruguayan Skirt Steak Skewers
description: A spicy twist on traditional Chinese street food, these Uruguayan skirt steak skewers are marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, garlic, and chili flakes, then grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, garlic, chili flakes, brown sugar, and sesame oil.
Add the skirt steak and chorizo to the marinade, and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated meat and vegetables onto skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the meat is cooked to your liking.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped scallions if desired.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles if desired.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
